summary: No Stopping zone on a busy multi-lane arterial with no parking lane.
reasons: Line sits in the live traffic lanes

drivers.seclusion: Fully exposed; houses 23-27 m away on the north side, shops opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: No verge or pull-off; the road edge is a retaining wall or live lane, nowhere to stop clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with buses and trucks, signals at the east end.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this side; no stopping signed at all times.

sun_shade: Open; trees shade the north side.
cannot_judge: Exact extent of the no-stopping zone
